reference_title: California Trenching and Shoring Manual (Caltrans, June 2011, Revision 2 - July 2025)
scope_note: Geotech / excavation-engineering content only. The PDF has an intact text layer (no OCR required). Chapter text JSON authored for the design-relevant chapters: 2 (Cal/OSHA soil types & slopes), 3 (Soils), 4 (Earth Pressure), 6 (Structural Design), 7 (Unrestrained/cantilever shoring), 8 (Restrained/braced/anchored shoring - apparent earth pressure), 10 (Special Conditions - anchor blocks, heave, piping, slope stability). The administrative/legal Chapters 1, 5, 9, 11 and Appendices A-D are out of the digitized-text scope (their figures are still in the figure catalog). The figure catalog was built by labeled-caption page search (figure-catalog-builder methodology); all 177 figures are page-confirmed (page_estimated=false).
